scientific_scope.boundary: Paper-defined categorical MGW quantities are distinct from repository constructions, bounds, examples and formalizations. A local Lean result proves its exact typed target under recorded definitions, imports and axiom policy; it does not certify all publication prose or close hosted replay. No calibration, continuous-PID transfer, learning benefit or priority claim follows.

companions.evidence: Three locally accepted Lean targets and a locally accepted portable replay.
companions.limits: Expectation convergence is not consistency of an observed estimate, finite-horizon accuracy or a confidence interval; hosted proof replay remains open.
companions.name: Prefix mean
companions.purpose: Connect the specified row experiment to a population signed MGW atom.
companions.scope: Nonempty finite source set on finite alphabets; normalized joint law; complete redundancy lattice; h+1 IID complete rows with a fresh anchor; within-row coordinates may depend.

companions.limits: Sampling variation, finite-sample coverage, Rust correspondence and hosted replay are separate; observed occupancy does not prove a population floor.
companions.name: Prefix bias
companions.purpose: Choose or reject a finite horizon using explicit approximation-error and cost bounds.
companions.scope: The same finite row experiment; supported anchor events; any population floor must be separately justified.

companions.limits: Independent-block MSE is a handwritten consequence outside those eleven targets. Hosted replay, implementation, useful training, coverage and stopping validity are not established.
companions.name: Prefix gradient
companions.purpose: Relate the score of every row, including the anchor, to derivatives and finite-prefix error.
companions.scope: The same h+1 IID complete-row experiment with a fresh anchor; normalized finite laws on common positive support in an open neighborhood and bounded scores. The atom bound additionally requires zero target-fiber tangents and complete supported inverse identities.

companions.limits: No accepted Lean formalization or executed-fixture evidence. The failed quadratic path is retained; support change alone does not force a cusp.
companions.name: Support-change MI cusp
companions.purpose: Show why base-point cell tangents do not justify a derivative-limit interchange when support changes.
companions.scope: A declared four-cell binary path; the common-support derivative premise fails.

companions.limits: Complete replay acceptance remains open because operational evidence is incomplete. Explicit finite entropy sums are not an identification with a separate entropy library, task value, or sample-based target-copy inference.
companions.name: Target-copy synergy
companions.purpose: Provide finite-law identities and conditional-entropy bounds for a declared target-copy family.
companions.scope: T=(S1,U) at every supported joint key; complete source joint law; no independence/full-support premise. The formal same-law comparison uses one residual alphabet.

companions.evidence: Twenty-one local Lean checks and a retained replay using the same kernel implementation.
companions.limits: Reusable public replay and fresh hosted qualification remain open. The comparison is not a prediction/placement benefit, another-PID theorem or scientific-priority claim.
companions.name: Fixed-world added information
companions.purpose: Show that equal MGW synergy can accompany different added Shannon information in one matched world.
companions.scope: Assigned probabilities on an eight-outcome world with mutually independent fair bits; no sampling-IID premise.
